note: Lifted blacks are the whole point of a faded print: gamma 1.12 plus brightness raises input level 40 to 77,78,76, so nothing in frame is ever truly black. A slight magenta split (red AND blue up in shadows, green down in highlights) mimics dye fade. No film grain is added - a grade cannot make grain, and film grain was deliberately left OUT of the tags so this does not promise texture it has no way to deliver.
